name: De Meervaart, Meer en Vaart 300
surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012085435 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground (scripts/landmarks/meervaart-footprints.json, written by venue-prepare.ts). attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 massing (CC BY 4.0): the dark-brick base with its window rows and shopfronts, aluminium-clad halls, the brick fly tower with its aluminium crown and white 'meervaart' lettering, the north hall's 'meervaart:' sign and the panelled box with its big window. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
